title: ChatMessageWaiting
description: `data` of the chat.message_waiting event: someone has had a chat message from the other side of their order unread for a minute. Sent once per unread streak (until they read the chat), never to someone who has the chat open. notification-service tells them in their inbox and by SMS. Keyed by orderId.

senderName.description: The rider's name when the rider wrote; null when the customer did (riders don't learn customers' names)

preview.description: The latest waiting message, cut to 80 characters; empty for a photo without a caption

photo.description: The latest waiting message is a photo

since.description: When the first waiting message was sent
